name: Ashikaga Kazuha Yoshiteru
original_name: 足利 一葉 義輝
source:
Kazuha is the head of the Ashikaga Clan, shogun of the Ashikaga Shogunate, and one of the main female protagonists and main heroines in the Sengoku†Koihime series. She is whimsical, impulsive, and fundamentally a person that needs looking after. That job generally goes to her attendant, Yuu, who takes care of most of the details.  

She is a master of the blade and a student of Tsukahara Bokuden.  She is far more at ease giving a beat-down to thugs in the streets than sitting behind a curtain in the palace.
